rows.quote: Next, we obtained the pQTL data of the filtered proteins from a total of 4,907 proteins in the deCODE database, as reported by Ferkingstad et al. (17).
rows.reference_quote: Ferkingstad E, Sulem P, Atlason BA, et al. Large-scale integration of the plasma proteome with genetics and disease. Nat Genet 2021;53:1712-21. 10.1038/s41588-021-00978-w
rows.coder_note: Sentence attributes the deCODE pQTL data to Ferkingstad et al., citation 17, whose DOI is the source DOI of exactly one dictionary row.
